_note: Numbers invented for the damage, time, crit, streak and enemy-skip rules (owner B, missions 2-5). Check them. min_enemy_damage: an enemy hit never does less than this. rounding: round = half goes up, floor = always down, ceil = always up. time_limit_seconds: seconds per question by difficulty. typed_extra_seconds: extra seconds for a typed answer. crit_tiers: an answer that uses at most this share of its time limit is a crit; checked from the fastest. streak: bonus_per_right for each right answer in a row, up to max_multiplier. enemy_skip_chance: chance the enemy skips its turn after a miss. Tier damage and bonus_damage are in moves.json; enemy damage is in enemies.json.
